patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro dos doentes e dos hospitais

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant that, giving ourselves to works of charity, we may merit to be found among the elect in your Kingdom.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos que, praticando as obras de caridade, mereçamos ser contados entre os eleitos no vosso Reino.

meta.face: A lean, ascetic Portuguese-Spanish man of about fifty with an olive complexion and a long, angular face — a high, bare forehead with a pronounced baldness over the crown and short dark hair only at the sides and back, a long, straight nose with a slight hook at the bridge, dark, deep-set eyes under strongly arched dark brows, sharp, angular cheekbones over hollow cheeks, a narrow mouth; a thin dark moustache and a short, sparse dark beard only on the chin, and eyes lowered with grave compassion.
meta.basis: Pedro de Raxis the Elder, who may have known him, painted the portrait (Casa de los Pisa, Granada) that fixed his type: a long, angular, ascetic face, a balding head and a thin moustache and small beard; the seventeenth-century statues follow it. The pomegranate with a cross and the Granada setting come from his tradition.
